Apache-2.0. SVG paths are converted without redrawing.
Floating/docked toolbar actions now use Miuix artwork; the keyboard and arrows remain in use for keyboard controls.
Split keyboard rotates the official splitscreen artwork by 90 degrees to match left/right separation.
Layout actions use the rounded outlined keyboard symbol, shared by the toolbar and layout settings. The resize handle uses a custom six-dot grip.
